blocks.name: Halogens & Alkanes
blocks.definition: describe the reactions of alkanes with halogens in the presence of ultraviolet radiation, limited to mono-substitution knowledge of reaction mechanisms is not required

blocks.md:
- In a [substitution reaction](https://www.savemyexams.com/igcse/chemistry/edexcel/19/revision-notes/4-organic-chemistry/4-1-introduction/4-1-3-classifying-organic-reactions/), one atom is swapped with another atom
- Alkanes undergo a substitution reaction with halogens in the presence of ultraviolet radiation

blocks.text: The reaction between methane and bromine in the presence of ultraviolet radiation

blocks.alt: Substitution-Alkanes-&-Halogens, IGCSE & GCSE Chemistry revision notes

blocks.md: ***In the presence of ultraviolet (UV) radiation, methane reacts with bromine in a substitution reaction***
- The equation for the reaction is
- Chlorine will also react with alkanes under the same conditions to form chloromethane

- The products belong to a family called halogenoalkanes or haloalkanes
- Halogenoalkanes have many uses as solvents, refrigerants, propellants and pharmaceuticals

blocks.label: Exam Hint
blocks.md: CFC stands for chlorofluorocarbon, an important class of halogenoalkanes, previously used in fridges and air conditioners, but gradually being phased out because of the damage they cause to the ozone layer.
